LETTER OF EMPLOYMENT

Dear {{ doc.official_name or "__________" }},

Following our recent discussions, {{ doc.company_name or "__________" }} is delighted to extend you an offer of employment as {{ doc.designation or "__________" }} {% if doc.effective_date %} W.E.F {{ doc.effective_date }}.{% endif %}

We value your expertise and are confident you will be an important part of this small ecosystem we have created here. As a member of this ecosystem, we ask for your commitment to delivering outstanding quality and results that exceed client expectations. In addition, we expect your accountability in all the products, actions, advice, and results you provide as a representative of our organization. In return, we are committed to providing you with every opportunity to learn, grow and stretch to the highest level of your ability and potential.

Your annual gross salary will be {% if doc.annual_salary %}Lakhs. {{ doc.annual_salary }}{% else %}__________{% endif %}.

Annexure
Compensation and Benefits
Name {{ doc.official_name or "__________" }}
Designation {{ doc.designation or "__________" }}
Department {{ doc.department or "__________" }}
Compensation component Annual Monthly
Basic Salary {{ doc.annual_salary or "" }} {{ doc.basic_salary or "" }}
Fuel Allowance    
Attendance Allowance    
Annual Gross Salary    










Terms and conditions
  1. EMPLOYMENT

    1. ({{ doc.company_name or "Xperts Global AI Pvt Ltd" }}) With its office (hereinafter the “Employer” or “Company”) employs, engages, and hires an employee to work for the Company and also supervises teams, as and when necessary, and Employee accepts and agrees to work for the company on full-time basis (for a term commencing with date hereof and count through Date:- {{ doc.join_date or "__________" }} unless the employment is sooner terminated as provided herein) until Date:- __________ or the employment is terminated as provided herein, such hiring, engagement, and employment, subject to the general supervision and according to the orders, advice, and direction of Employer.

  2. JOB DESCRIPTION / DUTIES
    1. The Employee shall be working from the Company’s Karachi office. However, to give the Employee wider exposure during employment, the Employee may, in the future, be transferred to any other section or department in the same establishment or may be transferred to any other establishment (existing or which may be set up in the future) under the same management.
    2. The Employee agrees that during the Employment Period, he/she shall devote his/her agreed time to fulfilling his/her duties related to the Company's business affairs. The duties of the Employee shall include the performance of all the duties typical of the office held by an employee as described in the Bylaws of the Company and such other duties and actions as may be assigned by a superior officer of the Company. The Employee shall devote his/her entire agreed productive time, ability, and attention to the business of the Company and shall perform all duties in a professional, ethical, and Responsible manner. The employee shall uphold the Company’s reputation for integrity and high standards of business conduct. These duties may be altered as per the requirements of the Company. The Employee shall be assigned duties as per the requirements of the Company.
    3. The Employee shall devote not less than 9 hours a day to a workday, including lunch/refreshment break, and 5 days a week to business activities for the Company. The working hours are subject to change as per business requirements. Depending upon business requirements from time to time, the Employee may be asked to work on Saturdays, if needed. The Training Period shall be non-paid.
    4. The Employee agrees not to cause any hindrance to the movement of men, materials, and vehicles to and from the premises of the Company or indulge in any act prejudicial to the business or Goodwill of the Company.
    5. During employment with the Employer or even after the Employee is discharged for whatever reasons if it is established that due to the Employee’s malicious intention, the functioning of the Company was crippled and the Company suffered financial loss or damage to its image or its Reputation and goodwill, then the Company has the right to initiate civil or criminal proceedings against the concerned Employee.
    6. Employee will be working for One Month as a coordinator if required he/she will be working on the same.
  3. SALARY / EMOLUMENTS AND STATUTORY DUES
    1. The Employee will be entitled to a yearly gross salary of Rs {{ doc.annual_salary or "__________" }} which includes the travel allowance. The Company depending upon Employee’s performance may increase the aforesaid salary as it deems fit to do so. Salary will be paid before the 10th of each subsequent month.
    2. The Employee shall not, at any given point in time, disclose or divulge salary details to anyone, whether in or out of the Company’s premises. Breach of this clause shall be tantamount to a breach of this appointment letter and legal/appropriate action will be taken as per applicable legislation.
    3. 3.3. Bonus: As additional compensation for services to be rendered under this Agreement, the Employee shall be entitled to a bonus income on the following basis:
      1. Performance bonus based on your performance & as per Company norms, the payout of which will be dependent on parameters ({{ doc.company_name or "Xperts Global AI Pvt Ltd" }}) and will be determined from time to time.
  4. NOTICE PERIOD AND PROBATION
    1. The Employee will be on probation for a period of three to six months (“Probation Period”). During and after probation, the Employee shall be at liberty to resign from the Company after taking an advance written approval/consent to the effect from the Company, at least 60 (sixty) days before the intended last working day (hereinafter referred to as “Notice Period”). In other words, the Notice Period shall commence from the date of submission of resignation failure. The employee would be liable to pay an amount equivalent to his last two months’ gross salary and incentives/perks drawn from the company.
    2. During the Probation Period the Notice Period can be shortened or even waived completely at the discretion of the Company if the management feels that the performance/conduct of the employee is not as per the Company’s standards, or the Employee is found guilty of gross misconduct. The Employee agrees that by failing to serve during the notice period, the Employee shall forfeit any claim to any impending payment of salary/perks/emoluments, etc. from the Company.
    3. The Parties reserve their right to take appropriate legal action as per the Pakistan Contract Act & Labor Laws if the breach of the aforesaid clause occurs. Additionally, the Employee agrees to pay damages to the Employer amount equal to the gross salary of the remaining period of the probation period if the employee decides to leave the company for the probation period on his own. The Employee shall also be responsible and penalized for the loss incurred by the Company due to project delays because of the abrupt absence of the Employee. In such a scenario the Company also forfeits its obligation to issue to the Employee a No Objection Certificate, Experience Certificate, Relieving Letter or/and Reference Letter, as the case may be.
  5. CODE OF CONDUCT
    1. Employee agrees never to use his / her position with the Company, or information acquired during employment in a manner that may create a conflict of interest (“Conflict of Interest”) or the appearance of a conflict of interest between the Employee’s personal interest and the interests of the Company or its customers, associates, and clients. To this clause, Conflict of Interest shall mean any situation in which the Employee is able to exploit his/her professional or official capacity in some way for his / her personal benefit. Conflict of Interest shall also mean multiple professional or personal interests of the Employee, one of which could possibly corrupt his / her motivation or intention towards job performance at the Company.
    2. Leaves: Employee will be entitled to the following leaves:
      • SL – Scheduled Leave (Paid leave) after approval from (Manager/ Director/HR)
      • USL – Un-scheduled Leave (Unpaid with deduction 1 day Salary but should be Authorized)
      • NCNS – No Call No Status (Deduction 2 days Salary)
  6. DOUBLE EMPLOYMENT AND NON-COMPETE
    1. The parties hereto agree that during the tenure of employment with the Company, the Employee shall wholly devote himself/herself to the Company and shall not undertake any other employment either in full or on a part-time basis without prior permission of the Company in writing. Any contravention of this will be considered a breach of this Agreement.
    2. The parties also agree, during employment with the Company, the Employee shall not, either by himself or in association with any other person carry on any business or be associated in any manner with any business especially which in the opinion of the Company is like or competitive with that carried by the Company (hereinafter referred to as “Double Employment”).
    3. Non–Compete: The Employee hereby covenants and agrees that during the term of this agreement and for a period of three (3) years after any termination or expiration thereof, without the Company’s prior written consent, Employee will not, without prior written consent of the Company, provide services, carry on, or be engaged in, or be concerned with, or interested in, or employed by, a competitive business and / or any person or organization engaged in or concerned with or interested in a business which is the same as, or substantially similar to, or in competition with, the Company’s business at the time of termination or resignation, as the case may be. The Employee understands that the foregoing restrictions are necessary and reasonable to protect Company’s goodwill and business.
  7. NON-DISCLOSURE
    1. Employee shall not at any time or in any manner, either directly or indirectly, divulge, disclose or communicate to any person, firm, corporation, or other entity in any manner whatsoever any information concerning any matters affecting or relating to the business of Employer, including but not limited to any of its customers, the prices it obtains or has obtained from the sale of, or at which it sells or has sold, its products, or any other information concerning the business of Employer, its manner of operation, its plans, processes, source code, company policies, incentive plans, software being deployed, client list, phone numbers and contact details of existing and prospective clients or other data without regard to whether all of the above-stated matters will be deemed confidential, material, or important, Employer and Employee specifically and expressly stipulating that as between them, such matters are important, material, and confidential and gravely affect the effective and successful conduct of the business of Employer, and Employer’s goodwill, and that any breach of the terms of this clause shall be a material breach of this Agreement. No employee under any circumstances shall discuss, reveal, or disclose any details of the meeting of the Board of Directors.
    2. During the tenure of employment, the Employee may have, or in the future may, develop certain products within the scope of his consultancy or otherwise within the scope of the Company’s current or potential lines of business. This work product may be created by the Employee at the Company’s premises, during normal work hours, or after hours at another location. This work product may be created by Employee alone or in conjunction with other employees or other third parties (hereinafter referred to as “Employer Proprietary Products”).
    3. Employees agree that the Company shall own all proprietary rights, including but not limited to copyrights, trade secret rights, patent rights, trademark rights, and all other intellectual property rights in and to the Employer Proprietary Products.
    4. Upon request from the Company, the Employee agrees to execute all documents and take any other actions reasonably necessary to secure ownership of the Employer Proprietary Products in the Company include but are not limited to executing assignments, applications, certificates and other instruments requested by the Company.
    5. Should the employee be in breach of the above terms, he/she shall be liable to make a good payment to the Company, the calculation of which shall be ascertained at the time of said breach.
  8. NON - SOLICITATION
    1. The Employee further agrees that during the term of this Agreement and following the termination thereof for a period of three years, whether the termination shall be voluntary or involuntary, or with or without cause, the Employee at no time may indicate or imply opportunities for employment, in any manner, or solicit or encourage any person, firm, corporation or other business entity who are clients, business associates or referral sources of the Company to either cease doing business with the Company or to do business with the Employee.
    2. In addition, Employee agrees that following termination of employment, or resignation, Employee will at no time and/or in no manner whatsoever solicit customers or clients of {{ doc.company_name or "Xperts Global AI Pvt Ltd" }}. By agreeing to this covenant, Employee acknowledges that their contributions to {{ doc.company_name or "Xperts Global AI Pvt Ltd" }} are unique to the Company’s success and that they have significant access to the trade secrets of the Company and other confidential or proprietary information regarding customers of the Company.
    3. Should the employee be in breach of the above terms, he/she shall be liable to make good payment to the Company, the calculation of which shall be ascertained at the time of said breach.
  9. DATA
    1. During the term of this Agreement, it is anticipated that the Employee will learn of or become exposed to data / information that the Company regards as confidential or proprietary, including but not limited to, information relating to the nature of research and/or development projects and data relating to services, customers, suppliers, personally identifiable information, pricing, costs, know-how, strategies, programs, processes, and other such practices and confidential and proprietary information. The Employee agrees that neither during the term of this Agreement nor after its termination, shall he / she utilize the said data / information in any form for any other purpose whatsoever other than for the purposes for which it has been accorded to the Employee.
    2. At the termination of this Agreement, or within three (3) days of receipt of a written request from the Company, the Employee shall return all data / information belonging to the Company that is in the possession of the Employee, including but not limited to all printed or reproduced material and information stored in electronic form and reports or other documents containing any such data information, failing which, the Company shall be well within its right to initiate civil or criminal proceedings, as the case may be, against the Employee.
  10. PENALTY
    1. If the Employee violates any of the provisions under Clauses [5, 6, 7, 8 &/or 9] of this Agreement (including, but not limited to, confidentiality, non-compete, or early exit obligations), the Employee shall be liable to pay the Company a financial penalty of PKR 1,000,000 (One Million Pakistani Rupees).
    2. Exception: This penalty shall not apply if the Employee has been provided with a No Objection Certificate (NOC) in writing by the Company permitting the relevant action.
    3. The parties agree that this penalty is reasonable, pre-estimated compensation for potential losses and is without prejudice to the Company’s other legal remedies under applicable Pakistani law.
  11. TERMINATION
    1. By the Company
      1. The Employee’s service shall be liable to termination without notice and without assigning any reason thereof (even during probation), if the Employee is found suspicious of wrong doings or indulge in illicit activity during his / her presence at the workplace or suppress any information or furnish false information with a view to obtain employment with the Company. Additionally, the Company takes no responsibility for unauthorized actions of the Employee, whether inside or outside the premises of the workplace which the employees perform without authorization of the company. The Employee shall be at liberty to terminate his / her employment with the Company subject to fulfillment of clause 4 above.
      2. The Employee agrees to bear all litigation charges, should the Employee be in breach of this Agreement.
      3. For any misconduct, without being exhaustive and without prejudice to the general meaning of the term "misconduct" in the case of reasonable suspicion of misconduct, disloyalty, commission of an act involving moral turpitude, any act of indiscipline or inefficiency.
      4. If the Employee remains absent from your duties, for 2 days continuously without any intimation or prior permission of your superior or for more than 3 days in a month.
      5. Employer reserves the right to terminate the services of the employee in case the employee is found under the influence of Alcohol/Drugs or any other intoxicating substance and further in case employer get the intimation regarding any person being involved in any offence relating to Alcohol/Drugs/ or any other criminal offence from the police or from any other source then also the employer can terminate the services without issuing any notice to the employee but only after its due satisfaction at its own level.
      6. Without being exhaustive, if the Employee indulges in any indecent behavior with any other employee of the Company or Company’s customer(s) or any activity, found objectionable to the Company.
      7. If the Employee is found/reported to have indulged or associated in any activity, which would without being exhaustive, include any anti-social, anti-national or immoral activity and any activity against the interest of the Company.
      8. If any information declared by the Employee or documents submitted thereof, at the time of interview/selection is found to be incorrect, forged or fabricated.
    2. By Employee
      1. In the event, if the Employee terminates this agreement within the mentioned one-year contract period then the Employee is liable to pay compensation equivalent to his/her remaining bond period months Gross salary to the company and in case the Employee fails to pay the compensation as per the provisions of this agreement then the company shall be entitled to initiate legal proceedings against such delinquent employee.
  12. SEVERABILITY
    1. Should any part of this document be rendered or declared invalid by a court of competent jurisdiction, such invalidation of such part or portion of this document should not invalidate the remaining portions thereof, and they shall remain in full force and effect.
  13. JURISDICTION
    1. All disputes arising out of this agreement shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts and arbitration in Karachi. IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this document on the first date above written.
